data.summary: E108: Fresh observation on Docker Hub (container registry) - view-count principle FAILS. Tested 55 need-related vs 55 random images. G1 PASS (sample size), G2 FAIL (Cliff's δ = -0.810, large effect in WRONG direction), G3 FAIL (Wilson LB = 0.000), G4 PASS. Random sample captured massive base images (alpine 12.3B, ubuntu 10.1B, node 7.1B, mysql 5.2B pulls) while need-related captured specialized infra tools (<10M pulls). Principle fails because container registries are dependency-heavy - base images accumulate pulls as FROM dependencies, not need-driven discovery. Per D083, next session must start fresh observation in new domain.
